description: Change the user's Auto Apply settings: turn it on or off (enabled), and set the default apply mode, the daily limit and the lowest match it applies to. While Auto Apply is on, GetMattered starts applications every day without a swipe. default_apply_mode "auto" sends them to the employer under the user's name without asking first, and a sent application cannot be undone. "review" prepares each one and holds it for approval. The default apply mode is also what getmattered_apply does when its mode is omitted. Call it only when the user asks to change these settings, never on your own. Turning Auto Apply on needs the Hired Yesterday plan; on another plan the answer says so and nothing changes. Returns the settings after the change. Do not use it to apply to one job; use getmattered_apply. Next: getmattered_get_applications to follow what Auto Apply starts.

daily_limit.description: Most applications Auto Apply starts in a day, 1 to 50. The plan's own daily cap can lower it. Omit to leave it as it is.

default_apply_mode.description: "auto": applications go to the employer without asking first. "review": each one waits for the user's approval. Also the mode getmattered_apply uses when its mode is omitted. Omit to leave it as it is.

enabled.description: true turns Auto Apply on, false turns it off. Omit to leave it as it is.

match_level.description: Lowest match Auto Apply applies to: "excellent" (90+), "strong" (80+), "good" (70+) or "stretch" (60+). Omit to leave it as it is.

name: getmattered_update_auto_apply

changed.description: The settings this call asked to change.

notConfirmed.description: True when the user declined the confirmation and nothing changed.

access.description: included or grace: the plan may run Auto Apply. Otherwise turning it on needs the top plan.

dailyLimit.description: Most applications Auto Apply starts in a day.

defaultApplyMode.description: auto: applications go to the employer without asking. review: each one waits for approval.

enabled.description: Auto Apply is on: GetMattered starts applications for the user every day, up to dailyLimit.

graceUntil.description: When access is grace: the moment Auto Apply stops on this plan.

matchLevel.description: Lowest match Auto Apply applies to: excellent 90+, strong 80+, good 70+, stretch 60+.

planDailyMax.description: The plan's own daily cap. dailyLimit never exceeds it.

sentLastDay.description: Applications Auto Apply started in the last 24 hours.

settings.description: The settings after the change. Null when the user declined the confirmation.
